status: New seven-package workshop over a previously exposed UNBench historical anchor
boundary: The package menu and private cards are fictional post-vote workshop inputs. No package alters the adopted resolution or asserts a future national position.

historical.fact: The Council adopted the draft 14–0–1 as resolution 2664 (2022). Brazil voted yes and India abstained.
India asked for a proactive role for the 1267 Monitoring Team and robust reporting. It said those concerns were not fully addressed in the adopted text.
The adopted text requested ERC briefings and emphasized the consideration of relevant information provided by the 1267 committee or its Monitoring Team, acting within its mandate.
